decisions: The OpenAI Agents SDK session strategy is now the only conversation continuation strategy; manual replay, provider Conversations, and previous-response chaining are not used.
SDK-compatible session items, pending questions, callback choices, compaction checkpoints, and paused approval state are application-encrypted; reasoning and provider metadata are excluded.
AGENT_SESSION_RETENTION_SECONDS defaults to 30 days and is validated between one hour and 30 days.
All live callback families record only sanitized family.action and authoritative application copy, using bounded CAS retry and idempotent operation receipts.
Owner reset/forget deletes conversation and approval continuity state while preserving commitments and product events.
deviations_from_plan: Independent review required three repair cycles: callback-family coverage, operational retention configuration, and retry-safe exactly-once callback context.

A review agent incorrectly triggered Railway deployment 0eacaf35-fcd8-42b5-aa51-4e9b373f493b before the story release gate. The service reached SUCCESS with no observed HTTP traffic; this deployment is not accepted as story evidence and is reconciled separately.
follow_ups: S02-02: consume the durable SDK session and callback/pending-question context through one typed-message orchestrator.
S02-05: include retention configuration, reset/forget, restart, callback replay, and the premature-deployment deviation in consolidated release verification.
log.context_for_next:
The application now uses a real Agents SDK session backed by encrypted Supabase items; manual six-turn replay is gone.
Provider storage remains false and reasoning/provider metadata are not retained.
Sessions survive draft completion and restart; owner reset/forget preserves domain commitments and events.
Working context is bounded while older items are available through opaque non-overlapping cursor pages.
All d/w/p/x/s/c callbacks persist sanitized context with bounded CAS retry and idempotent replay recovery.
AGENT_SESSION_RETENTION_SECONDS is optional, defaults to 30 days, and accepts one hour through 30 days.
Focused agent tests pass 58/58, full server tests pass 471/471, and server typecheck passes.
S02-02 may rely on the Session adapter and must not reintroduce manual history replay.

decisions: Every typed Telegram message, including /status, enters one ConversationService and agent-orchestration boundary.

History and product reads are bounded typed tools; provider storage remains disabled and application authorization remains authoritative.
Multiple unconfirmed drafts are permitted, but each mutating turn binds one owner-scoped draft ID and expected version.
Natural draft selection uses deterministic meaningful-token overlap; ties clarify without mutation and no fuzzy or semantic guessing is used.
/status delegates inside the unified boundary to deterministic StatusService output and preserves focus and pending interaction.

decisions: New commitment creation and active-commitment edits stage only from an interruption in the current durable SDK decision run; disconnected execution staging is removed for new flows.
SDK resume reconstructs the exact interrupted tool and authoritative proposal before RunState rehydration, then rechecks owner, session, entity, version, hash, expiry, and operation on invocation.
Approved commitment edits are one owner-scoped versioned transaction with append-only change events, idempotent receipts, and atomic obsolete-schedule replacement.
Time-changing edits recheck read-only Calendar availability before mutation and apply conflict or unverified-save policy without Calendar writes.
Target, preparation, and next-session edits are rejected while a related work session is started or awaiting check-in; its pending end check-in is preserved.
Legacy execution envelopes may still resolve for rollout compatibility but cannot be created by new conversation paths.
deviations_from_plan: Independent review found and required repairs for real Agents SDK RunState tool rehydration, remaining disconnected creation staging, and active-session end-check-in preservation.
Two obsolete ephemeral-session DB tests were updated to the durable Session contract so the complete database suite could remain green.
No S02-03 migration or implementation was applied to remote Supabase or deployed to Railway while the story was under review.
follow_ups: S02-04: accept flexible bounded preparation duration and natural constraints through the same durable decision run and exact draft authority.
S02-05: exercise real owner create/edit approval, restart, replay, Calendar recheck, and active-session edit rejection after deployment.
log.context_for_next:
Creation and active-commitment edits now pause and resume the same encrypted SDK decision run.
New approval staging uses only active-session stagePaused; legacy execution envelopes are resolution-only compatibility.
Creation/edit authority binds owner, session, exact entity/version, tool, proposal hash, expiry, and operation receipt.
Approved edits atomically version the commitment, append a change event, and replace only exact obsolete unsent schedules.
Time-changing edits recheck Calendar and never write to it.
Started or awaiting-check-in work sessions block plan edits and retain their pending end check-in.
Real SDK serialize/rehydrate/Runner tests cover approve, reject, absent tool, and mismatch fail-closed paths.
Clean DB suite passes 34/34; full check passes with 522 server, 22 release-verifier, and 50 Playwright tests.
Flexible duration and natural preparation constraints remain S02-04.

decisions: Preparation duration is an exact positive integer from 1 through 1440 minutes across agent, application, database, scheduling, continuation, edit, and dashboard boundaries.
Session starts remain on Singapore :00 or :30 boundaries; flexible durations may end on other quarter-hours and may cross midnight within exact constraints and target.
Natural preparation and continuation input uses exact draft or continuation authority in the same durable run; deterministic services own transitions and controlled Calendar copy.
A preparation answer supplied with the promise is incorporated immediately; the generic preparation question is asked only when the decision is genuinely missing.
Preparation duration evidence must bind the exact submitted value to preparation/work text and cannot borrow a relative target duration.
Every typed preparation or continuation outcome finalizes one authoritative Telegram update; row and audit identity survive transition, replay, and restart.
Ambiguous entity references are terminal decision-only outcomes before any work-session or continuation mutation dispatch.
Fixed-duration buttons remain optional shortcuts, while natural typed durations cover the complete bounded range and exactly one next session.
deviations_from_plan: Independent review required repair cycles for continuation duration coverage, same-message preparation, claimed-update finalization, update-row identity, start granularity, cross-midnight reachability, ambiguity ordering, target/preparation duration separation, finalizer propagation, and dashboard history validation.
Production-shaped DB tests exposed and repaired unbound repository method dispatch, an old model-audit duration enum, and a delete/reinsert FK conflict in same-message transitions.
No S02-04 migration or implementation was applied to remote Supabase or deployed to Railway while the story was under review.
follow_ups: S02-05: run a real owner conversation covering same-message 45-minute preparation, busy/free/unverified choice, approval, restart, replay, and natural 45-minute continuation.
S02-05: apply all additive Slice 02 migrations and verify the dedicated Railway service only after fresh explicit production approval.
log.context_for_next:
Natural preparation and continuation stay in one durable exact-authority agent run.
Durations are exact integers 1..1440 throughout app and database; 45 minutes is a first-class case.
Starts use Singapore :00/:30 boundaries; legal flexible sessions may cross midnight and end on other quarter-hours.
Same-message prep facts are incorporated without a redundant question, while relative target durations cannot become prep durations.
Free, busy, unavailable, provider-failure, owner-choice, no-prep, stale, ambiguity, and finalizer-failure paths preserve authority and finalize updates.
Continuation produces at most one next work session and two scheduled messages; fixed buttons are suggestions only.
Telegram update and audit row identity survive transitions, replay, and restart.
Clean DB suite passes 38/38; full check passes with 577 server, 22 release-verifier, and 50 Playwright tests.
S02-05 should deploy and verify these exact paths without adding new capability.
